_comment: Codex TUI 斜杠命令描述汉化表。key = 二进制里的英文原文（逐字一致），value = 中文。补丁保持字节等长：不足用空格补齐，超出则报 TOO_LONG。
create an AGENTS.md file with instructio: 创建 AGENTS.md 指令文件
summarize conversation to prevent hittin: 总结对话，避免超出上下文上限
review my current changes and find issue: 审查当前改动并找出问题
start or continue a conversation in a ne: 在新 worktree 中开始或继续对话
continue this session in the Desktop app: 在桌面应用中继续本会话
copy the last response or part of it: 复制上次回复或其部分
toggle raw scrollback mode for copy-frie: 切换原始回滚模式，便于复制
choose the TUI mode for the next launch: 选择下次启动的 TUI 模式
show git diff (including untracked files: 显示 git diff（含未跟踪文件）
use skills to improve how Codex performs: 用 Skills 优化 Codex 特定任务表现
import setup, this project, and recent c: 从 Claude Code 导入配置、项目与近期对话
view and manage lifecycle hooks: 查看管理生命周期 hooks
view retained warnings and diagnostic de: 查看保留的警告与诊断详情
show current session configuration and t: 查看会话配置与 token 用量
view account usage or use a usage limit: 查看账户用量或使用额度重置
show config layers and requirement sourc: 查看配置层与需求来源（调试）
include current selection, open files, a: 包含 IDE 选区、打开文件等上下文
start or stop voice; use /voice settings: 开关语音；用 /voice settings 选音色
set or view the goal for a long-running: 设置或查看长任务目标
open the agent command center: 打开 Agent 指挥中心
start a side conversation in an ephemera: 在临时派生中开始侧边对话
choose what Codex is allowed to do: 选择 Codex 权限范围
toggle Vim mode for the composer: 切换输入框 Vim 模式
set up elevated agent sandbox: 配置提权 Agent 沙箱
approve one retry of a recent auto-revie: 批准一次自动审查被拒的重试
list MCP tools; use /mcp verbose or /mcp: 列出 MCP 工具；用 /mcp verbose 详述
print the rollout file path: 打印 rollout 文件路径
